senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. עָרַב I) [to be well-mixed, seasoned, cmp. esp.
units: Targ. Ex. XXX, 35,] to be sweet, pleasant.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:36">Lam. R. to I, 9</cite> <he>יֶעֱרַב לך</he>, v. <cite ref="B01003"><he>בָּסֵם</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 8:4">Deut. R. s. 8</cite> <he>יערב עליכם</he> much good may it do you; a. fr.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 306:4">Sifré Deut. 306</cite> <he>מְעָרְבִים וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00153"><he>עָדַן</he></cite>.—Part. pass. <cite ref="M02092"><he>מְעוּ֫רָב</he></cite>; f. <he>מְעוּרֶבֶת</he>.

<cite ref="Ketubot 17a:1">Keth. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>לעולם תהא דעתו של אדם מע׳ עם הבריות</he> at all times man’s disposition should be sweet in associating with men, i.e. sympathize with their feelings; <cite ref="Tractate Derekh Eretz Rabbah 6">Treat. Der. Er. ch. VI</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 11b:17">Ber. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>הַעֲרֶב נא וכ׳</he> let, I pray thee, the words of thy Law be sweet in our mouths &c.
